caption:
The video captures a sunset over a calm sea. The low sun rests just above the horizon, throwing a bright golden column of reflection across the rippling water. A silhouetted coastline with a path and trees curves along the left, while a heavy band of purple and orange cloud fills most of the sky. The camera holds essentially still as the cloud edges slowly reshape and the dark central mass shifts subtly against the coastline.

A small airplane silhouette enters at the left edge of the sky, just above the horizon line. It travels steadily from left to right at roughly constant altitude, crossing the lower sky beneath the dark central cloud mass. Then it passes through the bright glare surrounding the sun and continues toward the right side of the scene before moving out of view at the far right edge.

The sky is left without the airplane once more as the sun remains low, its golden reflection shimmering as ripples change while the clouds keep their slow drift.
